caption_L1: Here a is a area chart named U.S. merchant wholesalers ' gross margin on durable goods from 2002 to 2018 (in billion U.S. dollars). Year is defined using a linear scale from 2005 to 2015 along the x-axis. The y-axis plots Gross margin in billion U.S. dollars with a linear scale of range 0 to 800.
caption_L2L3: Revenue grew from approx $340b in 2002 to approx £720b in 2018. Between 2002 to 2007 the trend was positive showing year-on-year growth. 2007-2008 showed a significant drop in gross margin to levels last seen around 2003. It took approximately three years (in 2010) for levels to return to the equivalent of 2007-2008 levels.
